name: Dungeon Crawler + RPG Shop
concept_focus: Systems on shared state, then a real map: grids, fog, procedural levels, pathfinding and saves

story.title: Below the Old Mine
story.client: Foreman Brigid of the collapsed Deepvein mine
story.hook: The Deepvein mine broke into something older than the mine, and things keep climbing out. Brigid needs a crawler built: first the fights and the shop, then a real map below, one that changes every time you go down, so her miners can practise before they face the Core.

acts.title: Act I: The First Descent
acts.goal: Player state, a fight, potions and gold that stays with you.

acts.title: Act II: The Run
acts.goal: Varied enemies, a shop, numbered rooms with events and a mini-boss that ends runs.

acts.title: Act III: The Deep Map
acts.goal: A grid to walk, fog of war, equipment, generated mazes and a path-finding guide.

acts.title: Act IV: The Core
acts.goal: Save and load the whole run, and a boss with phases at the bottom.

boss_lore: The Core is the dungeon's heart. Every room you walked through was part of it, and it has been learning your path.
boss_brief: Bring a finished crawler.py: shared player state, fights, potions, a shop and gold, a generated grid map with fog and a guaranteed exit, equipment that changes stats, path-finding, a full save and load, and a phased boss at the bottom.

mobs.name: The Hollow Adventurer
mobs.encounter: Decide what the player must carry between rooms and how to keep HP, attack, gold and potions together in one place.
mobs.contract: Brigid's first miner went down with a pocketful of numbers and lost half of them by the second room. Keep everything the player is in one place.

objectives.label: Pack the player
objectives.brief: In crawler.py, keep the player's name, HP, max HP, attack, gold and potions in one dictionary.

objectives.label: Show the status
objectives.brief: Write a function that prints a one-line status from that dictionary.

objectives.label: Explain one place
objectives.brief: Explain why one dictionary is safer than six loose variables once functions start changing the player.

mobs.name: The Tunnel Rat
mobs.encounter: Make one enemy fight work with attack and run choices, and explain when the enemy gets to act.
mobs.contract: Something with teeth blocks the tunnel. Fight it, or run, and know who strikes when.

objectives.label: Fight the rat
objectives.brief: Loop a fight where the player chooses attack or run and the enemy strikes back after the player's turn.

objectives.label: Run away
objectives.brief: Let running succeed on a chance, and give the enemy a free hit when it fails.

objectives.label: Order the turns
objectives.brief: Explain the bug where a dead enemy still strikes back, and show your loop checks first.

mobs.name: The Potion Leech
mobs.encounter: Let the player heal from a limited potion supply and reason about what should happen when it runs out.
mobs.contract: The Leech drinks your potions when you are not looking. Count them carefully and never drink one you do not have.

objectives.label: Drink a potion
objectives.brief: Add a potion choice in a fight that heals without passing max HP and uses one potion.

objectives.label: Handle an empty flask
objectives.brief: Refuse to heal when there are no potions left, without wasting the player's turn.

objectives.label: Stop the overheal
objectives.brief: Explain how a potion could take HP above max HP and show your fix.

mobs.name: The Gold Goblin
mobs.encounter: Award gold after a victory and explain why the reward must land on the same player state that survives into the next room.
mobs.contract: The Goblin pays well, but only if the coins land in the purse you carry out of the room.

objectives.label: Pay the reward
objectives.brief: Write a function that gives the player gold after a win by changing the player dictionary passed in.

objectives.label: Carry it onward
objectives.brief: Fight two enemies in a row and show the gold and HP carry over between them.

objectives.label: Explain the lost coins
objectives.brief: Explain why gold = gold + 10 inside a function does not change the player's gold, while player['gold'] += 10 does.

mobs.name: The Spawn Pit
mobs.concept: Randomness and functions that build data
mobs.encounter: Generate enemies with different stats so fights vary, and explain where randomness enters each one.
mobs.contract: The pit spits out something new each time: bigger, faster, nastier. Make enemies from templates plus a little chaos.

objectives.label: Write enemy templates
objectives.brief: Keep enemy types (name, base HP, attack, gold) in a list of dictionaries.

objectives.label: Spawn an enemy
objectives.brief: Write make_enemy(depth) that copies a random template and varies its stats, stronger the deeper you are.

objectives.label: Keep templates clean
objectives.brief: Explain why damaging an enemy made from a template without copying it would weaken every later enemy of that type.

mobs.name: The Merchant Shade
mobs.concept: Shop loop with lists and dictionaries
mobs.encounter: Build a shop that shows items and prices, checks affordability, updates gold and inventory, and lets the player leave empty-handed.
mobs.contract: A shade sells potions and blades by lantern light. It never gives credit and never lets you leave with what you did not pay for.

objectives.label: Open the shop
objectives.brief: Show the items and prices as a numbered menu, with the player's gold.

objectives.label: Buy an item
objectives.brief: Buying takes the gold and adds the item or its effect in one step; refuse it if the player cannot afford it.

objectives.label: Leave the shop
objectives.brief: Let the player buy several things or none and leave when they choose.

mobs.name: The Floor Stalker
mobs.encounter: Advance through numbered rooms with random events and reason about how the game knows a shop is due.
mobs.contract: The Stalker follows you room to room. Count the rooms, roll what is in each, and open a shop every few.

objectives.label: Walk the rooms
objectives.brief: Loop through numbered rooms where each holds a fight, treasure or nothing at random.

objectives.label: Schedule the shop
objectives.brief: Open the shop every fifth room using the room number and %.

objectives.label: Predict the shops
objectives.brief: Predict which rooms from 1 to 20 have a shop, then run it.

mobs.name: The Mini-Boss
mobs.encounter: Bring a tougher encounter every few rooms and end the run on death with a final score.
mobs.contract: Every tenth room something big is waiting. Beat it and go deeper; fall and the run is over, with your score carved on the wall.

objectives.label: Schedule the mini-boss
objectives.brief: Make every tenth room a stronger enemy with a bigger reward.

objectives.label: End the run
objectives.brief: End the run when the player dies and show rooms cleared, gold and a score.

objectives.label: Explain the score
objectives.brief: Explain how your score is calculated and why it rewards going deeper over hoarding gold.

mobs.name: The Cartographer
mobs.encounter: Replace numbered rooms with a grid the player walks across.
mobs.contract: Brigid's miners need a real map: rooms side by side, walls between them, and a hunter who can walk north, south, east and west.

objectives.label: Lay out the grid
objectives.brief: Store the level as a list of lists of tiles (floor, wall, exit) with the player's position as a row and column.

objectives.label: Walk the grid
objectives.brief: Move the player with n, s, e and w, refusing walls and the edge of the map.

objectives.label: Draw the map
objectives.brief: Print the grid with the player's position marked.

mobs.name: The Fog Lantern
mobs.encounter: Show only the tiles the player has seen.
mobs.contract: Below the mine there is no light but your lantern. Show what you have seen, and nothing you have not.

objectives.label: Remember what was seen
objectives.brief: Keep a set of seen positions and add the player's tile and its neighbours after every move.

objectives.label: Draw with fog
objectives.brief: Draw unseen tiles as fog and seen ones as they are.

objectives.label: Light the edges safely
objectives.brief: Explain why marking neighbours at the map edge can crash or wrap around, and how you prevent it.

mobs.name: The Armourer
mobs.encounter: Let the player equip weapons and armour that change their stats.
mobs.contract: The Armourer will fit you out, but only one blade and one coat at a time. Swapping must never leave a stat behind.

objectives.label: Add equipment slots
objectives.brief: Give the player weapon and armour slots and items with stat bonuses.

objectives.label: Compute the real stats
objectives.brief: Work out attack and defence from base stats plus equipped items, every time, rather than adding bonuses into the base.

objectives.label: Swap without leftovers
objectives.brief: Explain what goes wrong if equipping adds a bonus to the base stat and unequipping forgets to remove it.

mobs.name: The Maze Wright
mobs.encounter: Generate a new maze every level, always with a reachable exit.
mobs.contract: The deep changes every time you go down. The Wright carves a new maze each level, and it must always leave a way out.

objectives.label: Carve a maze
objectives.brief: Generate each level by carving floor through solid rock with a random walk from the start.

objectives.label: Place the contents
objectives.brief: Place the exit, enemies, treasure and a shop on floor tiles, never on the start.

objectives.label: Guarantee the exit
objectives.brief: Check the exit can be reached from the start (and regenerate if not), and explain how your check works.

mobs.name: The Pathfinder
mobs.encounter: Find the shortest path to the exit and offer to walk it.
mobs.contract: Brigid's miners get lost. The Pathfinder floods the map from where you stand and always knows the shortest way out.

objectives.label: Flood the map
objectives.brief: Write a breadth-first search over floor tiles that returns the shortest path from the player to the exit.

objectives.label: Offer a guide
objectives.brief: Add a guide command that shows the next step, and an auto-walk that stops if an enemy appears.

objectives.label: Trace the flood
objectives.brief: On a small hand-made map, predict the length of the shortest path, then check your search.

mobs.name: The Save Crystal
mobs.concept: Saving and loading the whole game
mobs.encounter: Save the run to a file and load it back exactly.
mobs.contract: The crystal remembers everything: where you stood, what you carried, what you saw. Touch it and you can leave the mine and come back.

objectives.label: Save the run
objectives.brief: Save the player, the map, the seen tiles, the depth and the enemies to a JSON file, converting anything JSON cannot store (such as sets).

objectives.label: Load the run
objectives.brief: Load a saved run and carry on exactly where it stopped.

objectives.label: Handle a broken save
objectives.brief: Make a missing or broken save file harmless and explain what the player sees in each case.

mobs.name: The Core Heart
mobs.encounter: Build the final boss: a fight that changes as it is hurt.
mobs.contract: At the bottom of the deepest level, the Core beats. It fights differently when wounded, and differently again when it is dying.

objectives.label: Give it phases
objectives.brief: Give the boss three phases by HP, each with its own attacks and a message when it changes.

objectives.label: Add a mechanic
objectives.brief: In the last phase, add a mechanic the player can see coming and must react to, such as a charged attack.

objectives.label: Win the game
objectives.brief: End the game with a victory screen, the run's stats, and an offer to start a fresh run.
